shortDescription: The Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane that crashed at Miami International Airport on Sunday increased thrust seconds before it overran the runway and hit two vehicles, according to Bloomberg. The US National Transportation Safety Board said the jet applied thrust before the runway overrun.
